description.narrative: The Initiation Plan (“IP”) will kickstart UNDP support to Serbia’s EU Accession Negotiations as coordinated by the Ministry for European Integration of the Republic of Serbia (“MEI”).In its first phase, the project will focus on the application of the new enlargement methodology as a priority. In particular, the IP will enable the development of the Roadmap for functioning democratic institutions as one of the requirements under the new methodology. Additional activities and outputs will be developed and added during implementation. In addition, the IP will support MEI to establish an effective and efficient organizational framework for managing the creation of the National Development Plan.This IP will also act as a resource mobilization vehicle for further developing of the project, at which point a full Project Document will be developed (within 18 months).

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
